title: 托福官方套题 12 · 口语

tasks.sample: We keep the larger microscopes over here.
Here are test tubes for mixing chemicals.
Light these burners to heat substances in experiments.
Always wear safety goggles in order to protect your eyes.
Follow proper procedures when disposing of your waste.
Record your observations accurately in a lab notebook that we provide to students.
After each experiment, remember to clean the laboratory equipment thoroughly.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for participating. I'd like to ask you about your cooking habits. Are there certain times of the day when you're more likely to cook something? For example, breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks?
(Interviewer) Great. When you cook, do you prefer following a recipe or creating your own dishes? Why?
(Interviewer) Interesting. Some people believe that learning to cook is an essential life skill, while others think it's not necessary in today's world. Which view do you agree with, and why?

(Interviewer) Good points. I just have one last question. Some people believe that in the future, food will mainly be about nutrition and convenience. Others believe that flavor, tradition, and culture will remain essential. What do you think food will be like in the future, and why?
